name: MCN7P
tagline: AMD Ryzen HS desktop PC with USB4 and dual 2.5GbE
description: MCN7P combines AMD Ryzen 7 7735HS, Ryzen 7 7840HS or Ryzen 9 7940HS processor options, up to 64GB DDR5, dual 2.5GbE, USB4, dual PCIe 4.0 NVMe slots and SATA storage in a 136 x 123 x 51 mm enclosure.

specifications.label: USB
specifications.value: 2 x USB 2.0; 2 x USB 3.0; 1 x USB4

specifications.label: Storage
specifications.value: 2 x M.2 slot for PCIE4.0 x 4 NVME 2280 SSD; 1 x SATA3.0 slot for SATA HDD or SSD

specifications.label: Expansion
specifications.value: 1 x SATA3.0 slot for SATA HDD or SSD; Wi-Fi5+BT4.2/Wi-Fi6+BT5.2

specifications.label: Front I/O - Ports
specifications.value: 1 x 3.5 mm audio jack; 2 x USB 3.2; 1 x Type-C (data)

specifications.label: Rear I/O - Ports
specifications.value: 2 x USB 2.0; 1 x HDMI; 1 x DP; 1 x USB4; 2 x RJ45; 1 x DC IN

specifications.label: Internal I/O - Headers
specifications.value: 1 x system cooling fan; 1 x half-size Mini PCIe slot for Wi-Fi/Bluetooth; 2 x M.2 slots for NVMe 2280 SSD; 1 x SATA 3.0 slot for HDD/SSD; 2 x DDR5 SO-DIMM slots
